regime_context: Detector shows a genuine absolute-trend regime (gate_helps=true), so trend discipline has historically cut drawdown here — that is the only validated edge. Cross-sectional momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), rotation breadth is narrowing (0.43) with AI Infrastructure still a clean leader over Semiconductor Equipment (margin 0.555) and no one-narrative dominance. Given direction accuracy is only 0.488 on 84 calls, I default to low conviction and a small number of leans.
emerging_watch: Watching AI Software & Platforms (rank 21, eligible, breadth 0.647) for a sustained move up the durability ladder — if its durability_bar crosses above 0.7 while remaining uncrowded (z < 1.0) and breadth stays above 0.6 for two consecutive weeks, the software leg of AI would be a more durable rotation than the current semi-heavy leadership; the watch retires if its score falls below zero or breadth drops under 0.5 first.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The leader is eligible (gate on), has the strongest durability bar among top-rank themes (0.73), high breadth (0.875), and is not crowded (z 0.81). This is a trend-following lean supported by the staying-power leg (absolute-trend gate) and cohesive leadership — not a momentum call. Rotation is narrowing rather than rolling, so the leader is not yet being handed off.
evidence: rotation leader with margin 0.555 over challenger
theses.dissent: The category is almost entirely SMH-proxied semiconductor beta; if the AI capex story stalls or semis rotate out as one block, the theme has no independent breadth to cushion it. Hurst tag is 'mixed', so the trend itself is not cleanly persistent.

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day moving average for five consecutive sessions before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Eligible, trend-tagged (hurst 'trend'), full breadth (1.0), and the strongest durability bar in the entire ranks (0.81). The only caution is crowding (z 1.91) — that is a size-down, not a fade. This is a genuine trend-health lean: the theme is displaying the cohesion and staying power the gate rewards.
theses.dissent: Crowding at z 1.91 means positioning is stretched; if a broad tech de-grossing occurs, the most-owned names get hit hardest and the full breadth (1.0) offers no internal diversification.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SPY by more than 6% over any rolling 10-day window before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Eligible and trend-tagged, but breadth is very weak (0.364) and durability is low (0.61). The detector's validated edge is shake-out avoidance via breadth/trend health; a trend theme with only 36% breadth is precisely the kind of fragile leadership the gate flags. This is a discipline call, not a return forecast.
evidence: crowding_z 0.68 (not stretched, but not supportive either)
theses.dissent: Energy has idiosyncratic upside catalysts (geopolitics is the #2 macro theme, unscheduled share 0.4) that can lift a low-breadth complex sharply and suddenly — avoiding it may miss a supply-shock spike.

falsifier.text: XLE closes at a 6-month high while breadth (fraction of constituents above their 50-day) rises above 0.6 before the 20-day check-by date
